def clean(df):
    # Fix species - strip whitespace
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip()
    
    # Fix island - standardize case to match allowed values
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.capitalize()
    
    # Fix body_mass_g - remove commas and convert to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Fix flipper_length_mm - convert to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].astype(float)
    
    # Fix year - convert to numeric
    df['year'] = df['year'].astype(int)
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and calculate average body mass
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
